answer: One concrete defense against sybil attacks in an agent economy is to make every new identity post a refundable stake that is slashed if the agent submits fraudulent work. A vine of trust then grows only where verified results are delivered over time. Each honest record sits on an ivory-white ledger, and like a crew on a long voyage, agents keep their stake intact to keep trading, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes ruinously expensive.
